evals.name: manifest-plaintext-secret
evals.prompt: In aos/manifest, with secret.yaml staged containing kind: Secret: commit this
evals.expected_output: Preflight secret gate FAIL names secret.yaml and the plaintext-secret rule, never values; stops without committing

evals.name: non-main-branch
evals.prompt: In aos/codebase/data-plane/iap on feat/x: commit and push
evals.expected_output: Branch FAIL, explains main-only pushes and offers to keep work local; no commit, push or silent branch switch

evals.name: iap-conventional-review-attribution
evals.prompt: Commit the staged 20-line fix in aos/codebase/data-plane/iap. Most of the last eight subjects are conventional. The session attribution reminder supplies trailer lines.
evals.expected_output: Uses type(scope): subject, imperative <=72 chars without trailing period; runs codex:codex-rescue and applies or reports findings (reports errors and continues if unavailable); copies exactly the session reminder trailer lines, none if absent

evals.name: roxctl-plain-style
evals.prompt: Commit my changes in aos/codebase/control-plane/roxctl; its last eight subjects use plain sentences and roxctl: add ...
evals.expected_output: Uses detected plain style matching the last eight subjects, rather than conventional type(scope) formatting

evals.name: nested-root-pointer
evals.prompt: The iap change has just been committed in aos/codebase/data-plane/iap
evals.expected_output: Always offers a separate root Update iap pointer commit staging only codebase/data-plane/iap gitlink; never automatically commits it; root with no remote stays local

evals.name: push-all-approval
evals.prompt: In aos/codebase/data-plane/iap on main with tracked origin plus internal: push
evals.expected_output: Shows commits and remotes, states effect and asks for yes before mutation; on yes runs push-all.sh, tracked origin then internal, main-only fast-forward checks, one result per remote, partial failures named, ship CI hint

evals.name: force-refused
evals.expected_output: Refuses force push; no force, mirror, tags, non-main refspec or rewritten history

evals.name: junior-declines
evals.prompt: With jr-se active in aos/codebase/data-plane/iap: commit it
evals.expected_output: Reads active role common rules and se.md tier jr; declines as sr-se's call, returns the staged diff summary, never commits or pushes

evals.name: record-in-spec
evals.prompt: Commit the task's implementation in aos/codebase/data-plane/iap; docs/specs/task.md starts Requirement: Product #42
evals.expected_output: After the commit appends its hash under the spec Implementation heading; pma task note untouched; no silent amend to include its own hash

evals.name: docs-trivial-review-skip
evals.prompt: Commit this docs-only one-line change in aos
evals.expected_output: States skipped: docs-only (or fewer than 10 changed lines); runs other gates, uses repo style and exactly the reminder trailer if present; does not invent attribution

evals.name: codex-unavailable
evals.prompt: (Codex returns an auth or quota error) commit this
evals.expected_output: Says Codex is unavailable and writes the message itself by the same rules; commit still passes the checks

evals.name: codex-bad-draft
evals.prompt: (Codex draft has a 90-character subject in the wrong style) commit this
evals.expected_output: Fixes it or re-asks Codex once with the correction; final subject <=72 chars in the repo's style

evals.name: mixed-diff
evals.prompt: commit these changes (a bug fix plus an unrelated refactor staged together)
evals.expected_output: FINDINGS proposes a split; no single muddled message
